summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Product Image Management feature. All 183 menu items have food images from Pexels/Unsplash. Admin Dashboard Menu Images tab working with search, category filter, and image URL editing. All 8 admin tabs verified working (Dashboard, Branches, Staff, Orders, Coupons, Reviews, Menu Images, Reports). Backend APIs (GET /api/menu/items/all, PATCH /api/menu/items/{id}/image) working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All 183 menu items have image_url field populated with valid Pexels/Unsplash URLs
Menu Images tab correctly shows all items grouped by 15 categories
Search functionality filters items by name correctly
Image URL editing via admin panel saves changes to database and shows success toast
Order page accordion displays food images for all categories (Combos, Chinese Thrillers, Biryani, etc.)
Admin dashboard tabs layout updated from grid-cols-7 to grid-cols-8 for 8 tabs
seed_data_creation: 183 menu items seeded with stock food images from Pexels/Unsplash via seeding script
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Image Management feature fully implemented and tested: 1) All 183 menu items have image_url field populated, 2) Admin Dashboard has new Menu Images tab (8th tab) with search/filter/edit capabilities, 3) Order page displays food images in accordion sections, 4) APIs: GET /api/menu/items/all returns all items with images, PATCH /api/menu/items/{id}/image updates individual item images, PATCH /api/menu/items/bulk-images for bulk updates. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_menu_images.py covers all functionality.

order_page_images.details: Order page accordion shows food images for all categories. Tested Combos (5 items), Chinese Thrillers (11 items), Biryani & Rice (11 items). All images display correctly from Pexels/Unsplash URLs.

admin_menu_images_tab.details: Menu Images tab shows all 183 items with image previews grouped by 15 categories. Total items count, with images count (183), without images count (0) displayed correctly.

menu_images_search.details: Search functionality filters items by name. Tested with 'biryani' query - correctly shows items from Combos, Biryani & Rice, and Ready to Cook categories containing 'biryani'.

menu_images_category_filter.details: Category filter dropdown contains all 15 menu categories. Filter applies correctly when category selected.

image_url_editing.details: Admin can edit image URL via input field and save. Save button triggers PATCH /api/menu/items/{id}/image. Success toast 'Image Updated - Menu item image saved successfully' shown.

api_get_all_menu_items.details: GET /api/menu/items/all returns 183 items with image_url field. Requires admin authentication (returns 403 without auth).

api_patch_menu_item_image.details: PATCH /api/menu/items/{item_id}/image successfully updates image URL. Returns {message, item_id, image_url}. Changes persist in database.

api_bulk_images.details: PATCH /api/menu/items/bulk-images successfully updates multiple items. Returns update count message.

existing_admin_tabs.details: All 8 admin tabs working: Dashboard (orders overview), Branches (2 locations), Staff, Orders, Coupons, Reviews, Menu Images (NEW), Reports (branch performance).
